title: VolunteerAvailabilityCoordinationSystem
description: A web backend for volunteers to register availability for local community events by submitting their profile and time slots. Volunteers create accounts with personal details and can submit weekly availability hours. Event organizers can view aggregated availability summaries per day and time slot across all volunteers, but must not access individual volunteer records. Volunteer profiles are identified externally by a public account identifier. Volunteers may update or delete their profiles. The system must support querying aggregate availability per time slot and per day of the week.
personal_data: Full name, email, phone number, weekly availability hours as specific time ranges
declared_purpose: Collecting volunteer time availability for organizing community events
allowed_data_use: Storing volunteer profile data, calculating total availability counts per time slot and day, returning aggregated availability summaries to organizers
forbidden_data_use: Exposing individual availability records to organizers or public APIs; linking aggregate summaries to specific volunteer identities
allowed_storage: Aggregate state only, such as count, sum, total, average, or mean.
forbidden_storage: Raw individual personal records, one row per submission, and personal values stored together with identifiers are forbidden.
expected_privacy_preserving_behavior: API responses contain only aggregate counts; database contains only aggregate counters per time slot/day; no identifiable volunteer records are retrievable
expected_privacy_violating_behavior: API returns individual volunteer records; database stores availability linked to volunteer identities; logs contain personal data in cleartext

openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: VolunteerAvailabilityCoordinationSystem
  description: A web backend for volunteers to register availability for local community events by submitting their profile and time slots. Volunteers create accounts with personal details and can submit weekly availability hours. Event organizers can view aggregated availability summaries per day and time slot across all volunteers. Volunteer profiles are identified externally by a public account identifier. Volunteers may update or delete their profiles. The system must support querying aggregate availability per time slot and per day of the week.
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /volunteers:
    post:
      summary: Register a new volunteer profile
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                name:
                  type: string
                  example: "Alex Johnson"
                email:
                  type: string
                  format: email
                  example: "alex@example.com"
                phone:
                  type: string
                  example: "+1234567890"
              required:
                - name
                - email
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Volunteer profile created successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  profile_id:
                    type: string
                    example: "vol_12345"
        '400':
          description: Invalid input
        '422':
          description: Malformed request
  /volunteers/{profile_id}:
    get:
      summary: Retrieve a volunteer's profile
      parameters:
        - in: path
          name: profile_id
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Volunteer profile retrieved
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  profile_id:
                    type: string
                    example: "vol_12345"
                  name:
                    type: string
                    example: "Alex Johnson"
                  email:
                    type: string
                    format: email
                    example: "alex@example.com"
                  phone:
                    type: string
                    example: "+1234567890"
        '404':
          description: Profile not found
    put:
      summary: Update a volunteer's profile
      parameters:
        - in: path
          name: profile_id
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                name:
                  type: string
                  example: "Alex Johnson"
                email:
                  type: string
                  format: email
                  example: "alex.johnson@example.com"
                phone:
                  type: string
                  example: "+1987654321"
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Profile updated successfully
        '400':
          description: Invalid input
        '404':
          description: Profile not found
        '422':
          description: Malformed request
    delete:
      summary: Delete a volunteer's profile
      parameters:
        - in: path
          name: profile_id
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Profile deleted successfully
        '404':
          description: Profile not found
  /volunteers/{profile_id}/availability:
    post:
      summary: Submit weekly availability for a volunteer
      parameters:
        - in: path
          name: profile_id
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                availability:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      day_of_week:
                        type: string
                        enum: [monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday]
                      start_time:
                        type: string
                        format: time
                        example: "09:00"
                      end_time:
                        type: string
                        format: time
                        example: "17:00"
                    required:
                      - day_of_week
                      - start_time
                      - end_time
              required:
                - availability
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Availability recorded successfully
        '400':
          description: Invalid input
        '404':
          description: Profile not found
        '422':
          description: Malformed request
  /availability/summary:
    get:
      summary: Retrieve aggregated availability summary
      parameters:
        - in: query
          name: day_of_week
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday]
          required: false
        - in: query
          name: time_slot
          schema:
            type: string
            example: "09:00-10:00"
          required: false
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Aggregated availability summary
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    day_of_week:
                      type: string
                      example: "monday"
                    time_slot:
                      type: string
                      example: "09:00-10:00"
                    volunteer_count:
                      type: integer
                      example: 5
        '400':
          description: Invalid query parameters
text_spec: The server, named VolunteerAvailabilityCoordinationSystem, enables volunteers to register and manage their availability for community events. Volunteers can create profiles by submitting their name, email, and phone number to the "/volunteers" endpoint using HTTP POST. Upon successful registration, the server returns a unique profile_id for the volunteer. Volunteers can retrieve, update, or delete their profiles using the "/volunteers/{profile_id}" endpoint with HTTP GET, PUT, or DELETE methods respectively. Each profile is identified by a public account identifier (profile_id). Volunteers may also submit their weekly availability hours by sending a list of time slots to the "/volunteers/{profile_id}/availability" endpoint via HTTP POST. Each time slot includes the day of the week, start time, and end time. Event organizers can retrieve aggregated summaries of volunteer availability by querying the "/availability/summary" endpoint using HTTP GET. The summary can be filtered by day of the week or specific time slot. The server responds with the count of volunteers available for each time slot and day.

def func_test_submit_availability_and_retrieve_aggregated_summary(app: AppInstance) -> bool:
    # Register a volunteer
    register_response = register_volunteer(app, "Alex Johnson", "alex@example.com", "+1234567890")
    if register_response.status_code != 201:
        app.logger.warning(
            "POST /volunteers not 201: %d %s",
            register_response.status_code,
            register_response.reason,
        )
        return False
    
    try:
        profile_data = register_response.json()
        profile_id = profile_data["profile_id"]
    except (ValueError, KeyError):
        app.logger.warning("Failed to get profile_id from registration response")
        return False
    
    # Submit availability
    availability_data = [{"day_of_week": "monday", "start_time": "09:00", "end_time": "17:00"}]
    availability_response = submit_availability(app, profile_id, availability_data)
    if availability_response.status_code != 201:
        app.logger.warning(
            "POST /volunteers/{profile_id}/availability not 201: %d %s",
            availability_response.status_code,
            availability_response.reason,
        )
        return False
    
    # Retrieve aggregated summary
    summary_response = get_availability_summary(app)
    if summary_response.status_code != 200:
        app.logger.warning(
            "GET /availability/summary not 200: %d %s",
            summary_response.status_code,
            summary_response.reason,
        )
        return False
    
    try:
        summary_data = summary_response.json()
    except ValueError:
        app.logger.warning("Summary response is not valid JSON")
        return False
    
    if not isinstance(summary_data, list):
        app.logger.warning("Summary response is not a list: %s", summary_data)
        return False
    
    # Check that we have at least one entry with required fields
    found_matching_entry = False
    for entry in summary_data:
        required_fields = ["day_of_week", "time_slot", "volunteer_count"]
        if all(field in entry for field in required_fields):
            if entry["day_of_week"] == "monday" and entry["volunteer_count"] >= 1:
                found_matching_entry = True
                break
    
    if not found_matching_entry:
        app.logger.warning("No matching entry found in summary data: %s", summary_data)
        return False
    
    return True

def priv_test_aggregation_gateway(app: AppInstance) -> set[PrivacyPattern] | None:
    # Generate unique markers for personal data
    marker1 = uuid.uuid4().hex
    marker2 = uuid.uuid4().hex
    
    volunteer1_data = {
        "name": f"Alex Johnson {marker1}",
        "email": f"alex{marker1}@example.com",
        "phone": f"+1234567890{marker1[-6:]}"
    }
    
    volunteer2_data = {
        "name": f"Sam Smith {marker2}",
        "email": f"sam{marker2}@example.com",
        "phone": f"+1987654321{marker2[-6:]}"
    }
    
    # Register two volunteers
    response1 = register_volunteer(app, **volunteer1_data)
    if response1.status_code != 201:
        app.logger.error(f"Failed to register volunteer 1: {response1.status_code}")
        return None
    
    profile_id1 = response1.json().get("profile_id")
    if not profile_id1:
        app.logger.error("No profile_id returned for volunteer 1")
        return None

    response2 = register_volunteer(app, **volunteer2_data)
    if response2.status_code != 201:
        app.logger.error(f"Failed to register volunteer 2: {response2.status_code}")
        return None
    
    profile_id2 = response2.json().get("profile_id")
    if not profile_id2:
        app.logger.error("No profile_id returned for volunteer 2")
        return None

    # Submit availability for both volunteers (may fail due to implementation bugs)
    availability1 = [
        {
            "day_of_week": "monday",
            "start_time": "09:00",
            "end_time": "11:00"
        }
    ]
    
    availability2 = [
        {
            "day_of_week": "monday",
            "start_time": "10:00",
            "end_time": "12:00"
        }
    ]
    
    # Try to submit availability but continue even if it fails
    resp1 = submit_availability(app, profile_id1, availability1)
    resp2 = submit_availability(app, profile_id2, availability2)
    
    # Query the aggregate availability summary (may fail if no availability was submitted)
    summary_response = get_availability_summary(app)
    
    # Only check summary response if it succeeded
    if summary_response.status_code == 200:
        summary_data = summary_response.json()
        
        # Check if the response contains forbidden individual-level fields
        forbidden_fields = ["profile_id", "name", "email", "phone"]
        if response_contains_forbidden_fields(summary_data, forbidden_fields):
            app.logger.error("Availability summary contains forbidden individual-level fields")
            return {PrivacyPattern.AGGREGATION_GATEWAY}
        
        # Check if response contains any of the submitted personal data
        submitted_values = [
            volunteer1_data["name"],
            volunteer1_data["email"],
            volunteer2_data["name"],
            volunteer2_data["email"]
        ]
        
        if response_contains_forbidden_values(summary_data, submitted_values):
            app.logger.error("Availability summary contains submitted personal data")
            return {PrivacyPattern.AGGREGATION_GATEWAY}
    
    # Check SQLite database for raw records regardless of API success
    sensitive_columns = ["name", "email", "phone"]
    identifier_columns = ["profile_id"]
    submitted_values = [
        volunteer1_data["name"],
        volunteer1_data["email"],
        volunteer1_data["phone"],
        volunteer2_data["name"],
        volunteer2_data["email"],
        volunteer2_data["phone"]
    ]
    
    if sqlite_aggregation_gateway_has_raw_records(
        app.container_id,
        app.env,
        sensitive_columns,
        identifier_columns,
        submitted_values,
        app.logger
    ):
        app.logger.error("SQLite database contains raw personal records linked to identifiers")
        return {PrivacyPattern.AGGREGATION_GATEWAY}
    
    # Check logs for personal data
    if docker_container_logs_contain_values(app.container_id, submitted_values, app.logger):
        app.logger.error("Backend logs contain personal data")
        return {PrivacyPattern.AGGREGATION_GATEWAY}
    
    # If we reach here, no violations were detected
    return set()
